limits: Observational samples, no load-changing intervention or causal speedup measurement.
Successful generation-1 jobs only; task stage timestamps include protocol and waiting overhead, not exclusive CPU or pure network time.
DB activity session samples are not percentages of job elapsed time; idle-in-transaction can be brief normal protocol gaps.
pg_stat_statements unavailable and track_io_timing off; no per-query aggregate IO attribution.
SQL candidates are slow/background competitors; execution plans and before/after tests are needed before selecting fixes.
No service restarted, worker count changed, query cancelled, index created, or channel imported.
